name: Web Development
tagline: Build websites and web apps that people use every day.
summary: Web developers create everything you see and use in a browser, from simple portfolio pages to full apps with logins and databases. It is one of the easiest fields to start in because you only need a laptop and a browser.
bestFor: Wants to build real projects early
timeEstimate: Roughly 6 to 12 months of steady practice for entry-level skills (varies a lot by person)

stages.title: Stage 1: Web foundations
stages.goal: Build and style static, mobile-friendly pages.
topics: CSS layout with Flexbox and Grid

stages.title: Stage 2: JavaScript
stages.goal: Make pages interactive and talk to APIs.

stages.title: Stage 3: Frameworks and tools
stages.goal: Build bigger interfaces faster with React.

stages.title: Stage 4: Backend and full projects
stages.goal: Build and deploy a complete app with a database.

name: App Development
tagline: Create apps that live on people's phones.
summary: App developers build mobile apps for Android and iOS. You can start with one cross-platform tool like Flutter, or go deep on native Android with Kotlin.
bestFor: Loves using apps and wants to build one
Wants to publish something people can install
timeEstimate: Roughly 6 to 12 months of steady practice for entry-level skills (varies a lot by person)

stages.title: Stage 1: Programming basics
stages.goal: Get comfortable with one app language.
topics: Pick a path: Dart (Flutter) or Kotlin (Android)

stages.title: Stage 2: Building screens
stages.goal: Design and navigate between app screens.

stages.title: Stage 3: Data and APIs
stages.goal: Make your app work with real data.

stages.title: Stage 4: Polish and publish
stages.goal: Ship a finished app.

resources.name: Flutter: build and release for Android

name: Data Science and AI
tagline: Find patterns in data and teach computers to learn.
summary: Data scientists and AI engineers turn data into answers and predictions. You will use Python, statistics, and machine learning to solve problems like recommendations, forecasting and image recognition.
bestFor: Likes finding stories hidden in numbers
timeEstimate: Roughly 9 to 15 months of steady practice for entry-level skills (varies a lot by person)

stages.title: Stage 1: Python and maths
stages.goal: Write Python and understand the maths behind data.

stages.title: Stage 2: Data analysis
stages.goal: Clean data and explain it with charts.

stages.title: Stage 3: Machine learning
stages.goal: Train and evaluate your first models.

resources.name: Kaggle Learn: Intro to Machine Learning

stages.title: Stage 4: Deep learning and projects
stages.goal: Build a portfolio of real AI projects.

name: Cybersecurity
tagline: Protect systems, data and people from attacks.
summary: Cybersecurity professionals find weaknesses and defend against attacks. Paths include penetration testing, security operations (SOC) and cloud security. You must only practise on systems you own or have permission to test.
timeEstimate: Roughly 9 to 15 months of steady practice for entry-level skills (varies a lot by person)
note: Practise only in legal environments such as labs, CTFs and your own machines. Never test real websites or networks without written permission.

stages.title: Stage 1: IT and networking basics
stages.goal: Understand how computers and the internet work.

stages.title: Stage 2: Security fundamentals
stages.goal: Learn the main threats and defences.

stages.title: Stage 3: Hands-on practice
stages.goal: Practise safely in labs and CTF games.

stages.title: Stage 4: Specialise
stages.goal: Pick a direction and build proof of skills.
topics: Choose: pentesting, SOC analyst or cloud security

name: Cloud and DevOps
tagline: Run apps reliably on the internet at any scale.
summary: Cloud and DevOps engineers deploy, automate and monitor software so it stays online. You will work with servers, containers and pipelines that take code from a laptop to the world.
bestFor: Interested in how big apps run
timeEstimate: Roughly 9 to 15 months of steady practice for entry-level skills (varies a lot by person)
tools: AWS, Azure or Google Cloud free tier
projects: Host a static site on the cloud

stages.title: Stage 1: Linux and networking
stages.goal: Be comfortable working on servers.

stages.title: Stage 2: Cloud fundamentals
stages.goal: Understand core cloud services on one provider.
topics: Pick one: AWS, Azure or Google Cloud

stages.title: Stage 3: Containers and CI/CD
stages.goal: Automate building and shipping an app.

stages.title: Stage 4: Infrastructure as code and monitoring
stages.goal: Manage infrastructure with code and keep it healthy.
topics: Deploy a full project end to end

name: UI/UX Design
tagline: Design apps and websites that feel simple to use.
summary: UI/UX designers decide how a product looks and how it works for the user. You will research real people, sketch ideas, build prototypes and test them, with very little coding needed.
bestFor: Creative and notices small visual details
Cares about making things easy for people
timeEstimate: Roughly 4 to 9 months of steady practice for entry-level skills (varies a lot by person)

stages.title: Stage 1: Design basics
stages.goal: Make clean, readable layouts.

stages.title: Stage 2: UX research
stages.goal: Understand users before designing.

stages.title: Stage 3: Tools and prototyping
stages.goal: Turn ideas into clickable prototypes.

stages.title: Stage 4: Portfolio
stages.goal: Show your thinking, not just screens.

name: Software Engineering
tagline: Master problem solving and core computer science.
summary: This path focuses on data structures, algorithms and core CS subjects, the base for most software jobs and campus placements. It pairs well with any other career on this list.
timeEstimate: Roughly 6 to 12 months of steady practice for interview-ready skills (varies a lot by person)
tools: One main language (C++, Java or Python)

stages.title: Stage 1: Programming and logic
stages.goal: Think in code with one language.
topics: Pick one language: C++, Java or Python

stages.title: Stage 2: Data structures
stages.goal: Know which structure fits which problem.

stages.title: Stage 3: Algorithms
stages.goal: Solve problems under time pressure.

stages.title: Stage 4: Core CS and interview prep
stages.goal: Be ready for technical interviews.
